# CONF-022: Server negotiates an outdated initialize-era revision

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| info | legacy era, stdio, http | [2025-11-25/basic/lifecycle#version-negotiation](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/lifecycle#version-negotiation) |

When asked for 2025-11-25, a server SHOULD answer with the latest version it supports. This notes servers whose latest is 2025-03-26 or 2024-11-05: MCPProbe only detects those revisions and recommends upgrading. Info: an old revision is not a violation.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-022`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-022"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
